title: Enjoy a Pontoon on our beautiful Lake Bryan.
includes: Boaters education course given on site to anyone born in or after 1988 ($3) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Must be 18+ to drive (must present license or passport)
Guests are required to sign rental agreement and release of liability
policies: For drivers, anyone born in or after 1988 will be required to take a $3 boaters education course given on site. This is required by the State of Florida
Reservations required. Once you have purchased your ticket, please contact local supplier to confirm reservation.
Dress code: bathing suit or beach attire
All pontoon rentals require a pre-authorization of $500.00 in the event of physical damage.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The venue is Key West inspired for a relaxing escape from the hustle and bustle of Orlando!  This 2-hour boat rental is for your group only, up to 12 passengers.  Pricing includes gas, life jackets and a boat rental.  Feel free to bring food, drinks, and fishing equipment.
